 Order
1.  This petition is for quashing of FIR bearing no.112/2017 under Sections 420/467/468/471/120B IPC registered at police station E.O.W. South, Delhi.
2. It is stated the disputes was settled between the parties vide various settlement agreements.
3. Learned counsel for the complainant appears and submits the terms of the agreement dated 03.05.2019 annexed as Annexure P2 has not been adhered to by the parties.
Let the parties sit together and sort out the differences, if any.
